experiment.cold_definition: per NPU: request 0 admission through request 5 completion; six-request TTFT cohort and six-request compute busy time
experiment.warm_definition: per NPU: request 1 admission through request 5 completion; request 1--5 TTFT cohort and request 1--5 compute busy time
experiment.npu_utilization_definition: compute busy / per-NPU cohort window, then equal-weight mean across all 128 NPUs
experiment.ttft_definition: completion minus admission; external arrival queue wait excluded
experiment.slo_definition: TTFT <= alpha * layer-count * request compute-only layer time
experiment.survivorship_policy: simulate all six requests to completion and use fixed cohorts

results.metric_scope: one completed trace; per-NPU windows; TTFT is completion minus admission and excludes external arrival queue wait

cold.utilization_window: sequence 0 admission to sequence 5 completion, independently per NPU

warm.utilization_window: sequence 1 admission to sequence 5 completion, independently per NPU
